review.notes:
Zebrasplit signs in with a phone number and a 6-digit code that we text you. This demo account has no password, so please use the code route below rather than the password screen.

To sign in:
1. On the welcome screen tap "Log in".
2. On the "Log in" screen, tap "Text me a code instead" at the BOTTOM of the screen. (The "Continue with email or phone" button goes to a password screen, which this account does not use.)
3. Enter the phone number 5555550101 and tap "Send code".
4. Enter the code 123456.

5555550101 is a reserved test number with a fixed code, so no real SMS is sent and the code never changes. The account is "Jordan Test", already a member of two trips with expenses, so every screen has data in it.

What to look at:
- Open the trip "Cabo crew: Casa Azul", then tap "Close out" to see the settlement and the payment buttons.
- Each payment shows which app it will open. Tapping the small logo chip under a payment lets you switch between the apps that person accepts.

Notes on specific features:
- Zebrasplit never holds, moves or processes money, and never asks for bank or card details. The Pay button opens Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount pre-filled; the payment happens entirely inside that app. Payments can also just be marked as paid by hand.
- "Dazzle" is the in-app word for a trip (a group of zebras is called a dazzle). A "stripe" means a member has finished adding expenses.
- Receipt scanning: tap the camera on an expense to photograph a receipt. The photo is read to extract the line items and total. Any photo of a restaurant or store receipt works.
- Contacts access is only used to let the user pick who to invite, and only the numbers they select are ever sent.
- The account can be deleted in-app from Profile > Settings > Delete account.

en-US.title: Zebrasplit
en-US.subtitle: Split trip costs with friends
en-US.promoText: Everyone gets a zebra. Log what you paid, dress your zebra, and settle the whole trip with one payment each.
en-US.description:
Zebrasplit is the group expense tracker built for real life without the headaches, confusion, or paywalls.

Track every expense and see who’s finished adding their receipts. No confusion about when it’s time to settle up, the app signals the group the second everyone is ready, then squares up the whole trip with one payment each.

EARN YOUR STRIPES
A group of zebras is a dazzle. Every person on the trip has their own zebra  avatar; only without any stripes. Earn your stripes by finishing adding your expenses and tapping "Done."

One glance tells you exactly who’s ready to settle up and who’s holding up the dazzle. Send a quick nudge to the stragglers, or if someone ghosts, the trip host can lock the tab and close it out anyway.

DRESS YOUR ZEBRA
Hats, shades, chains, hoodies, jerseys, even a crown if you’ve earned it. Customize your look across every trip. 

HOW IT WORKS

- Start a trip and invite friends via contacts or phone number.
- Add expenses as they happen.
- Tap Done to earn your stripes when all your receipts are in.
- Settle up in one tap via Venmo, Cashapp, or Paypal. Zebrasplit calculates the fewest possible payments to get everyone square and opens Venmo, Cash App, or PayPal with the exact amount pre-filled.

SPLIT IT HOWEVER IT ACTUALLY HAPPENED
- Flexible math: Split evenly, by exact dollar amounts, percentages, or shares.
- By nights stayed: Late arrivals or early departures automatically pay their fair share.
- Receipt scanning: Snap a photo of the bill and claim items line by line.
- Multi-currency: Track spend in any currency with the real-time exchange rate locked in the moment you save.

ONE PAYMENT EACH
- Zebrasplit simplifies the payment strategy so you usually just pay one person, once.

Zebrasplit never touches your money, holds funds, or asks for your bank or card details. Prefer cash, Zelle, or wire? Just mark the balance as paid and you’re square.

INVITE BY TEXT
Add friends from your contacts or by phone number. They get a text with a link that opens Zebrasplit, where they accept the invite and start adding expenses.

100% FREE TO SPLIT
Splitting expenses, earning your stripes, and settling up are completely free. And always will be. Zebra drip is optional.
